add_trv.title: Add TRV
add_trv.description:
Enter the device name and its Zigbee2MQTT topic.

Example topic: zigbee2mqtt/Living Room TRV

data_description.device_name: A friendly name for this TRV, e.g. Living Room TRV
data_description.mqtt_topic: The full Zigbee2MQTT topic for this device, e.g. zigbee2mqtt/Living Room TRV

add_receiver.title: Add Receiver
add_receiver.description:
Enter the device name, its Zigbee2MQTT topic, and model.

Example topic: zigbee2mqtt/Hive Receiver

data.show_water_schedule_mode: Show schedule mode for hot water

data_description.device_name: A friendly name for this receiver, e.g. Hive Receiver
data_description.mqtt_topic: The full Zigbee2MQTT topic for this device, e.g. zigbee2mqtt/Hive Receiver
data_description.model: SLR1 = single channel, SLR2 = dual channel (heating + hot water), OTR1 = standalone

setup_groups.title: Room Group Manager
setup_groups.description: This creates the room group manager. Add TRVs first, then create groups from the room group manager Configure menu.

abort.groups_already_configured: Room group manager is already configured.

data_description.boiler_entity: Turned on when any group member calls for heat. Supports climate, switch, and input_boolean.
data_description.enable_diagnostics: Writes extra diagnostic entries to the HA log.

create_group.title: Create Room Group — Step 1 of 3
create_group.description: Enter a name for the new room group.

create_group_members.title: Create Room Group — Step 2 of 3
create_group_members.description:
Select TRVs for: {room_name}

{count} registered TRV(s) available.

create_group_sensors.title: Create Room Group — Step 3 of 3
create_group_sensors.description:
{room_name} — {member_count} TRV(s) selected.

Optionally add extra temperature sensors.

remove_group.title: Remove Room Group
remove_group.description: Select the group to remove. Member TRVs will be restored as individual devices.
